statement: Prove the complete public Hono service journey (H5, Section 7.1 items 1-9) on real compiled WASM components consuming Q2-Q5 and J1-J3: scaffold a Hono service via createHonoServiceProject with LagrangeRequestClient/LagrangeEnv typings, deploy a zero-operation HTTP-only service and a multi-operation service through ArtifactPayloadStore and clean-client receipt deployment, execute sequential operations with typed selector narrowing (Q2), paged multi-batch execution (Q3), and structured partials (Q4) on service-cell-v2 (Q5) verified against an independent oracle, exercise full HTTP Fetch fidelity (binary/text/byte-distinct JSON bodies, repeated query params, multiple Set-Cookie headers, HEAD, 204), overlapping Promise.all concurrency refusal, warm instance isolation, keyed replay/conflict/cross-principal isolation/two-waiter cancellation/uncertain outcome refusal (H4), in-flight generation pinning across live endpoint updates, and node restart/second-node activation from sealed ArtifactPayloadStore rows.
